labels.title: FileX version
labels.$comment: label associated to the instance, can be overridden at sample level. In this case it becomes read-only.

FX_STANDALONE.title: Use Standalone Mode
FX_STANDALONE.description: When defined, this macro will enable the standalone mode of FileX. If this is disabled, you should add the RTOS pack.

FX_DISABLE_ERROR_CHECKING.title: Disable Error Checking
FX_DISABLE_ERROR_CHECKING.description: Removes the config FileX error checking API, resulting in improved performance (up to 30%) and smaller code size.

FX_FAT_MAP_SIZE.title: Specify Number of Sectors for FAT
FX_FAT_MAP_SIZE.description: Specifies the number of sectors that can be represented in the FAT update map. Larger values help reduce unneeded updates of secondary FAT sectors.

FX_MAX_FAT_CACHE.title: Define Maximum Number of FAT Cache Entries
FX_MAX_FAT_CACHE.description: Defines the number of entries in the FAT cache.

FX_MAX_LONG_NAME_LEN.title: Define Maximum Length of Long File Names
FX_MAX_LONG_NAME_LEN.description: Defines the maximum size of long file names supported by FileX.

FX_MAX_SECTOR_CACHE.title: Define Maximum Number of Cached Sectors
FX_MAX_SECTOR_CACHE.description: Defines the maximum number of logical sectors that can be cached by FileX. The cache memory supplied to FileX at fx_media_open determines how many sectors can actually be cached.

FX_UPDATE_RATE_IN_SECONDS.title: Define Time Update Interval in Seconds
FX_UPDATE_RATE_IN_SECONDS.description: Defines the number of seconds the time parameters are updated in FileX.

FX_UPDATE_RATE_IN_TICKS.title: Define Time Update Interval in RTOS Ticks
FX_UPDATE_RATE_IN_TICKS.description: Defines the number of FreeRTOS ticks required to achieve the update rate.

FX_DISABLE_CACHE.title: Disable File System Cache
FX_DISABLE_CACHE.description: If enabled, the cache is disabled.

FX_NO_LOCAL_PATH.title: Disable Local Path Support
FX_NO_LOCAL_PATH.description: When enabled, local path support is disabled.

FX_SINGLE_THREAD.title: Enable Single Thread
FX_SINGLE_THREAD.description: Eliminates FreeRTOS protection logic from the FileX source. Use if FileX is being used only from one thread or without FreeRTOS.

FX_DISABLE_DIRECT_DATA_READ_CACHE_FILL.title: Disable Direct Data Read Cache Fill
FX_DISABLE_DIRECT_DATA_READ_CACHE_FILL.description: If enabled, the direct read sector update of cache is disabled.

FX_DONT_UPDATE_OPEN_FILES.title: Don't Update Open Files
FX_DONT_UPDATE_OPEN_FILES.description: If enabled, FileX does not update already opened files.

FX_DRIVER_USE_64BIT_LBA.title: Enable 64-bit LBA in Driver
FX_DRIVER_USE_64BIT_LBA.description: If enabled, 64-bit sector addresses are used in the I/O driver.

FX_MAX_LAST_NAME_LEN.title: Define Maximum File Name Length
FX_MAX_LAST_NAME_LEN.description: Defines the maximum file name length, including the full path name. Must be as large or larger than Max Long Name Length.

FX_RENAME_PATH_INHERIT.title: Inherit Path on Rename
FX_RENAME_PATH_INHERIT.description: If enabled, renaming inherits path information.

FX_SINGLE_OPEN_LEGACY.title: Enable Legacy Single Open
FX_SINGLE_OPEN_LEGACY.description: If enabled, legacy single open logic for the same file is activated.

FX_DISABLE_FILE_CLOSE.title: Disable File Close Operation
FX_DISABLE_FILE_CLOSE.description: If enabled, file close is disabled.

FX_DISABLE_FAST_OPEN.title: Disable Fast File Opening
FX_DISABLE_FAST_OPEN.description: If enabled, fast open is disabled.

FX_DISABLE_FORCE_MEMORY_OPERATION.title: Disable Forced Memory Operations
FX_DISABLE_FORCE_MEMORY_OPERATION.description: If enabled, force memory operations are disabled.

FX_DISABLE_BUILD_OPTIONS.title: Disable Build Configuration Options
FX_DISABLE_BUILD_OPTIONS.description: If enabled, build options are disabled.

FX_DISABLE_ONE_LINE_FUNCTION.title: Disable Single-Line Functions
FX_DISABLE_ONE_LINE_FUNCTION.description: If enabled, one line function is disabled.

FX_DISABLE_FAT_ENTRY_REFRESH.title: Disable FAT Entry Refresh
FX_DISABLE_FAT_ENTRY_REFRESH.description: If enabled, FAT entry refresh is disabled.

FX_DISABLE_CONSECUTIVE_DETECT.title: Disable Consecutive Sector Detection
FX_DISABLE_CONSECUTIVE_DETECT.description: If enabled, consecutive detect is disabled.

FX_MEDIA_STATISTICS_DISABLE.title: Disable Media Statistics Collection
FX_MEDIA_STATISTICS_DISABLE.description: If enabled, gathering of media statistics is disabled.

FX_MEDIA_DISABLE_SEARCH_CACHE.title: Disable File Search Cache
FX_MEDIA_DISABLE_SEARCH_CACHE.description: If enabled, the file search cache optimization is disabled.

FX_NO_TIMER.title: Disable Timer Updates
FX_NO_TIMER.description: If enabled, FileX is built without updating the time parameters.

FX_ENABLE_FAULT_TOLERANT.title: Enable Fault Tolerance
FX_ENABLE_FAULT_TOLERANT.description: If enabled, the FileX fault tolerant service is activated.

FX_FAULT_TOLERANT.title: Enable Immediate System Sector Writes
FX_FAULT_TOLERANT.description: If enabled, system sector write requests (including FAT and directory entry requests) are flushed immediately to the driver.

FX_FAULT_TOLERANT_DATA.title: Immediate Data Flush on Write Requests
FX_FAULT_TOLERANT_DATA.description: If enabled, data sector write requests are flushed immediately to the driver.

FILEX_GENERATE_INIT_CODE.title: Generate Init Code
FILEX_GENERATE_INIT_CODE.description: Enable this option to configure the task settings

FILEX_APP_TASK_ENTRY.title: Define Application Task Entry Name
FILEX_APP_TASK_ENTRY.description: Specify the name of the main thread entry function for the FileX application.

FILEX_APP_TASK_NAME.title: Set Application Task Name
FILEX_APP_TASK_NAME.description: Specify the name of the task for the FileX application.

FILEX_APPLICATION_TASK_PRIORITY.title: Assign Application Task Priority
FILEX_APPLICATION_TASK_PRIORITY.description: Set the priority value for the FileX application task, determining its execution precedence.

FILEX_APPLICATION_TASK_STACK_SIZE.title: Specify Application Task Stack Size
FILEX_APPLICATION_TASK_STACK_SIZE.description: Define the stack size for the FileX application task, ensuring adequate memory allocation.

interface_type.title: Select interface
interface_type.description: Specifies the type of interface to be used.

FILEX_SD_FLAG_NONE.title: Disable All SD Flags
FILEX_SD_FLAG_NONE.description: Disable all special flags for the SD card operations. This is the default state with no additional features enabled.

FILEX_SD_FLAG_CACHE_MAINTENANCE.title: Enable Cache Maintenance
FILEX_SD_FLAG_CACHE_MAINTENANCE.description: Enable cache maintenance operations for the SD card. This helps in ensuring data consistency and performance.

FILEX_SD_FLAG_SCRATCH_BUFFER.title: Use Scratch Buffer
FILEX_SD_FLAG_SCRATCH_BUFFER.description: Enable the use of a scratch buffer for DMA operations when reading sectors from the SD card. This buffer should be 512 bytes in size.

FILEX_MMC_FLAG_NONE.title: Disable All MMC Flags
FILEX_MMC_FLAG_NONE.description: Disable all special flags for the MMC card operations. This is the default state with no additional features enabled.

FILEX_MMC_FLAG_CACHE_MAINTENANCE.title: Enable Cache Maintenance
FILEX_MMC_FLAG_CACHE_MAINTENANCE.description: Enable cache maintenance operations for the MMC card. This helps in ensuring data consistency and performance.

FILEX_MMC_FLAG_SCRATCH_BUFFER.title: Use Scratch Buffer
FILEX_MMC_FLAG_SCRATCH_BUFFER.description: Enable the use of a scratch buffer for DMA operations when reading sectors from the MMC card. This buffer should be 512 bytes in size.

FILEX_NOR_FLAG_NONE.title: Disable All NOR flash driver flags.
FILEX_NOR_FLAG_NONE.description: No special NOR flash driver flags enabled.

FILEX_NOR_FLAG_CLOSE_ON_UNINIT.title: Close NOR Flash Driver on Uninitialization
FILEX_NOR_FLAG_CLOSE_ON_UNINIT.description: Close the NOR flash driver when uninitializing.

FILEX_NAND_FLAG_NONE.title: Disable All NAND flash flags.
FILEX_NAND_FLAG_NONE.description: No special NAND flash driver flags enabled.

FILEX_NAND_FLAG_FORMAT_ON_INIT.title: Enable NAND Flash Formatting on Initialization
FILEX_NAND_FLAG_FORMAT_ON_INIT.description: Format the NAND flash on initialization.

FILEX_CONFIGURE_TASK.title: use task per interface
FILEX_CONFIGURE_TASK.description: Enable this option to configure the task settings

FILEX_APP_TASK_ENTRY.title: Define Application Task Entry Name
FILEX_APP_TASK_ENTRY.description: Specify the name of the main thread entry function for the FileX application.

FILEX_APP_TASK_NAME.title: Set Application Task Name
FILEX_APP_TASK_NAME.description: Specify the name of the task for the FileX application.

FILEX_APPLICATION_TASK_PRIORITY.title: Assign Application Task Priority
FILEX_APPLICATION_TASK_PRIORITY.description: Set the priority value for the FileX application task, determining its execution precedence.

FILEX_APPLICATION_TASK_STACK_SIZE.title: Specify Application Task Stack Size
FILEX_APPLICATION_TASK_STACK_SIZE.description: Define the stack size for the FileX application task, ensuring adequate memory allocation.

FILEX_SD_MAX_TIMEOUT.title: Set Maximum Timeout
FILEX_SD_MAX_TIMEOUT.description: This parameter defines the maximum timeout in milliseconds for a specific operation. The default value is 10,000 ms, which equals 10 seconds.

FILEX _SD_FORMAT_PERCENTAGE.title: Select the percentage of memory to format
FILEX _SD_FORMAT_PERCENTAGE.description: Enter the percentage of memory to format, between 1% and 100%. The exact size will be calculated automatically based on the memory capacity.

FILEX_SD_HIDDEN_SECTORS.title: Define Hidden Sectors
FILEX_SD_HIDDEN_SECTORS.description: Specify the number of hidden sectors on the SD card. These sectors are reserved and not accessible by the file system.

FILEX_SD_NUMBER_OF_FATS.title: Set Number of FATs
FILEX_SD_NUMBER_OF_FATS.description: Specify the number of File Allocation Tables (FATs) on the SD card. Typically, this is either 1 or 2.

FILEX_SD_DIRECTORY_ENTRIES.title: Set Directory Entries
FILEX_SD_DIRECTORY_ENTRIES.description: Specify the number of directory entries on the SD card. This determines how many files and directories can be stored in the root directory.

FILEX_SD_SECTORS_PER_CLUSTER.title: Set Sectors Per Cluster
FILEX_SD_SECTORS_PER_CLUSTER.description: Specify the number of sectors per cluster on the SD card. This affects the allocation unit size.

FILEX_SD_HEADS.title: Set Number of Heads
FILEX_SD_HEADS.description: Specify the number of heads on the SD card. This is typically set to 1.

FILEX_SD_SECTORS_PER_TRACK.title: Set Sectors Per Track
FILEX_SD_SECTORS_PER_TRACK.description: Specify the number of sectors per track on the SD card. This is typically set to 1.

FILEX_MMC_MAX_TIMEOUT.title: Set Maximum Timeout
FILEX_MMC_MAX_TIMEOUT.description: This parameter defines the maximum timeout in milliseconds for a specific operation. The default value is 10,000 ms, which equals 10 seconds.

FILEX_MMC_HIDDEN_SECTORS.title: Define Hidden Sectors
FILEX_MMC_HIDDEN_SECTORS.description: Specify the number of hidden sectors on the MMC card. These sectors are reserved and not accessible by the file system.

FILEX_MMC_SECTORS_PER_CLUSTER.description: Specify the number of sectors per cluster on the MMC card. This affects the allocation unit size.

FILEX_MMC_HEADS.title: Set Number of Heads
FILEX_MMC_HEADS.description: Specify the number of heads on the MMC card. This is typically set to 1.

FILEX_MMC_SECTORS_PER_TRACK.title: Set Sectors Per Track
FILEX_MMC_SECTORS_PER_TRACK.description: Specify the number of sectors per track on the MMC card. This is typically set to 1.

FILEX_NOR_VOLUME_NAME.title: Define NOR volume name
FILEX_NOR_VOLUME_NAME.description: Define the NOR flash volume name.

FILEX_NOR_SECTOR_SIZE.title: Set Sector Size
FILEX_NOR_SECTOR_SIZE.description: Specify the sector size for the NOR flash.

FILEX_NAND_VOLUME_NAME.description: Define the NAND flash volume name.

FILEX_NAND_SECTOR_SIZE.description: Specify the sector size for the NAND flash.

FILEX_NAND_HIDDEN_SECTORS.description: Specify the number of hidden sectors on the NAND flash. These sectors are reserved and not accessible by the file system.
